sequence: Operational exclusion/NOT_READY; independently approved original manifest/attestation and exact host/role allocation
Single ADMIN transaction: plain INSERT immutable header then original expected signed-attestation tuple; initialize required existing lifecycle/control rows
Canonical validation, permanent login allocation/tombstones and reviewed ACLs; commit both or neither
Separate activation/readiness evidence; never implicit READY
provisioning.additional_required_data: Expected signed-attestation input required by reverse FK, beyond header/embedded slots; no generic synthetic replacement approved

role_mapping_limit: Exact historical rehearsal allocation and assigned wrapper ACLs; not an active immutable-header assignment or approved host incarnation.

CANONICAL_SLOT_BINDING_FIELDS.slot_codec: u32 count 4; four length-prefixed records purpose 1..4, OID u32 and exact NFC UTF8 name; unique purposes/OIDs/names; consume every byte
CANONICAL_SLOT_BINDING_FIELDS.role: OID AND exact name; LOGIN true; INHERIT/SUPERUSER/CREATEROLE/CREATEDB/REPLICATION/BYPASSRLS false; no incoming/outgoing memberships, ownership, CREATE or grant options; direct authenticated session, not current_user
CANONICAL_SLOT_BINDING_FIELDS.binding: All 38 fields canonical, non-null and exact; fingerprint distinct from legacy plan digest; original retained manifest and signed commitment; immutable header and permanent login allocation
CANONICAL_SLOT_BINDING_FIELDS.incarnation: Header deployment/incarnation matches readiness and independently approved host/client config; normal restart preserves incarnation; clone/reincarnation requires governed fresh marker, invalidation and new identities
CANONICAL_SLOT_BINDING_FIELDS.policy: Header version/digest matches exact approved policy, full 29-tag bytes, effective_from and live readiness; no fixture2/time changes
CANONICAL_SLOT_BINDING_FIELDS.lifecycle: R permits bound auditor read including expired/revoked terminal binding; M requires ACTIVE, time window and eligible ceremony/attempt/generation/OWNED possession state. Login ACTIVE-only semantics are not supplied by R/M automatically
CANONICAL_SLOT_BINDING_FIELDS.revision: binding_schema_version + execution_plan_version + fingerprint + surface/policy/admission/delivery/reconciliation versions; no binding_revision column exists. Attempt generation is execution lifecycle, not header revision
